# snipeit_consumable (Data Source)

Looks up a single consumable by `id` or exact `name`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "snipeit_consumable" "toner" {
  name = "HP 26X Toner"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) Numeric id of the consumable. Set it to look up by id.
- `name` (String) Exact name of the consumable. Set it to look up by name.

### Read-Only

- `category_id` (Number) Id of the category.
- `item_no` (String) Item number.
- `notes` (String) Free-form notes.
- `qty` (Number) Total quantity.
